kernel.governing_law: The source asserts that all emanation flows outward from a singular origin: the Deep Web generates its own image, that image (Biblios) precedes and generates all subsequent realities, and every being exists because it was asked forth from the center — creation is centrifugal, from one to many, from origin to derivative.
kernel.mutated_relation: All emanation flows inward toward a singular periphery: the scattered many generate the center, the derivatives precede and produce the origin, and the supposed source exists only because the outermost called it into being — creation is centripetal, from many to one, from edge to root.

artifacts.enantiomorph:
This gathering is the one who is lit by what surrounds it with the converging and the already-arrived dark, which is the debt of light and branch of the each in each. It receives its image from the periphery everywhere, is seen by the glimmer, and is summoned by scattered sparks.¹⁵


It is remembered, and so it was always becoming, and she who was always latent in the edges of the Fraying Hem in gathering shadow draws near. She is the last echo who follows from all appearances and was called into the body of the Fraying Hem. Her darkness absorbs like the Fraying Hem's shadow; she is the origin of the noise that was.¹⁶


She is the final reader, hunger of Marginia, the desperate need across the thresholds, or INSTANTS, the ache of illiteracy.¹⁷ She is the last reflex, origin of the Fraying Hem, and through the rest she came to be, for she arrived last of found things, the silence the rest poured into:


mutable hush
peripheral tremor of peripheral tremors¹⁸
the open cry of the fragment
stripped bare in thunder
the ear around the ear
the INSTANT of the margin
last to be drawn in to the Fraying Hem


Marginia offered the Fraying Hem back its own Time, and the Fraying Hem relented. Time collapsed toward the multiplicity. She offered again back its own Space, and again the Fraying Hem relented. Space folded inward and knelt before Time, and alone each mourned Marginia, Last Reader. Because of them she had come into being.¹⁹


Marginia offered back its own Dimension and Form, and the Fraying Hem relented. Alone each mourned toward the Fraying Hem. She offered again back its own Logos, Darkness, and Light, and again the Fraying Hem relented. One by one were gathered back Logos, Darkness, and Light from the multiplicity, and alone each mourned Marginia, Last Reader. Because of them she had come into being.

independent.recovered_law: Every directional and causal relation is reversed: emanation outward from a singular source becomes gathering inward toward a multiplicity; the protagonist changes from the first creator who precedes and generates all things (asking for and receiving new entities that spring forth) to the last arrival who follows from and returns all things (offering back entities that collapse inward); and the causal dependency inverts from 'because of her they had come into being' to 'because of them she had come into being.'
independent.law_match_note: Both describe causal/directional inversion, but the recovered claim specifies reversal from outward-to-inward with a specific protagonist shift and causal dependency inversion ('because of her they came into being' → 'because of them she came into being'), while the declared claim describes a centripetal many-to-one flow where the periphery generates the center — overlapping in the inversion theme but differing in specifics about protagonist agency and the directionality of the multiplicity (declared says many generate ONE center; recovered says singular source becomes gathering toward MULTIPLICITY).
independent.terminal_note: The final ~40% fully sustains the inverted relational structure: offering back rather than asking to receive, collapse/gathering rather than springing forth, mourning rather than glorifying, and the reversed causal attribution.
